semiconductors.name: Semiconductors
semiconductors.summary: Microcontrollers, integrated circuits, memory, transistors, diodes and voltage regulators.
semiconductors.intro: The active parts at the heart of every board — from the MCU that runs your firmware to the regulator that keeps it powered.

passives.name: Passives
passives.intro: The capacitors, resistors and inductors that filter, store, divide and stabilise — in the values and packages your build calls for.

connectors.name: Connectors
connectors.intro: Board-to-board, wire-to-board, RF and I/O connectors from leading manufacturers. Send us the part number and we’ll quote stock and lead time.

electromechanical.name: Electromechanical
electromechanical.intro: Relays, switches, sensors and fans for control, protection and cooling. Send us the part number and we’ll quote stock and lead time.

obsolete.name: Obsolete & EOL
obsolete.summary: Discontinued part? We’ll find the last reels — or a qualified alternative.
obsolete.intro: When a manufacturer discontinues a part, your production doesn’t stop. We help you manage obsolete and end-of-life components by locating remaining stock or finding compatible replacements.

microcontrollers.name: Microcontrollers
microcontrollers.description: Integrated circuits that combine a microprocessor with memory and other peripherals. They are commonly used to control and manage electronic systems.

integratedCircuits.name: Integrated circuits
integratedCircuits.description: Miniaturised circuits of interconnected semiconductor devices that perform functions such as amplification, logic operations and data processing.

memory.name: Memory — RAM, ROM, Flash
memory.description: Semiconductor devices for data storage: RAM for temporary storage, ROM for permanent data and Flash for rewritable non-volatile storage.

transistors.name: Transistors
transistors.description: Semiconductor devices that amplify or switch electronic signals and currents — fundamental building blocks of modern electronics.

diodes.name: Diodes
diodes.description: Components that let current flow in one direction while blocking it in the other. Used in rectification, signal modulation and protection circuits.

voltageRegulators.name: Voltage regulators
voltageRegulators.description: Devices that hold a steady output voltage despite changes in input voltage or load, keeping the rest of the circuit reliably powered.

capacitors.name: Capacitors
capacitors.description: Passive components that store and release electrical energy, used for energy storage, noise filtering, voltage regulation and coupling.

resistors.name: Resistors
resistors.description: Components that limit the flow of current — used to control current, divide voltages and adjust signal levels.

inductors.name: Inductors
inductors.description: Passive components that store energy in a magnetic field, used for signal filtering, energy storage and magnetic field generation.

sourcing.name: Product sourcing
sourcing.short: Shortage and allocated parts located through a vetted global supplier network.
sourcing.long: Access to a wide range of suppliers and manufacturers, so we can source the specific semiconductors and passive components your requirements call for — including parts on shortage or allocation.

inventory.name: Inventory management
inventory.short: We hold buffer stock for you and release it on demand — off your balance sheet.
inventory.long: We maintain an extensive inventory of semiconductors and passive components to ensure availability and quick delivery, and can hold buffer stock for your programmes.

obsolescence.name: Obsolescence management
obsolescence.short: Last-time buys, EOL stock and cross-referenced alternatives for legacy designs.
obsolescence.long: We help you manage obsolete and end-of-life components by offering alternative solutions or finding compatible replacements, so legacy designs stay in production.

jit.name: Just-in-time delivery
jit.short: Scheduled releases timed to your production plan, shipped from the nearest hub.
jit.long: Just-in-time deliveries that meet tight production schedules, reduce lead times and minimise your inventory costs.

about.title: About
about.description: StarLink Components is a global stocking distributor of electronic components with offices in Canada, Germany and Hong Kong.
about.p1: StarLink Components is a global stocking distributor of electronic components with three offices worldwide. Since our establishment, we have been committed to providing high-quality components to customers around the world.
about.p2: As a stocking distributor, we carry a broad range of electronic components from leading manufacturers — semiconductors, passive components, connectors and electromechanical components, among others. Our inventory is constantly updated so the latest products are available.
about.p3: Our offices in Canada, Germany and Hong Kong are each staffed with experienced sales professionals who are ready to help with your component needs.
about.p4: We focus on reliable, efficient service, high-quality products and competitive pricing — and we believe in long-term relationships, delivering value in every interaction.

privacy.draft: Draft — pending legal review. Placeholders in [brackets] must be completed before launch.

controller.title: Who we are
controller.body: This website is operated by StarLink Components, [registered legal entity name and address]. Contact: sales@starlinkcomponents.com.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: When you send a request for quote we receive the details you enter — name, company, work email, part numbers, quantities, notes and any BOM file you attach — plus technical data such as your IP address, used to prevent abuse.

use.title: Why we use it
use.body: To answer your request and prepare a quotation (steps prior to entering into a contract), and to protect the form from spam and abuse (legitimate interest). We do not use your data for advertising and we do not sell it.

processors.title: Service providers
processors.body: The site is hosted by Vercel. Request emails are delivered by Resend. Rate limiting uses Upstash. These providers process data on our behalf and may store it outside your country under appropriate safeguards.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep quote requests for [retention period], unless a business relationship requires longer retention by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to processing or request portability by emailing sales@starlinkcomponents.com. You may also complain to your data-protection authority.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We set a single functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your language. We use no analytics or advertising cookies.
